findings.display_name: Production connector fails closed without credentials
Unclear rights default to restrictive policies
Thesis requires evidence, horizon, and invalidation
Event requires source credibility and timestamp
Factor signal requires liquidity / capacity check
Human review required for fraud / legal / short claims
Short action requires borrow + squeeze review
Sentiment / social signals require credibility + manipulation review
Invalidation display required on recommendation outputs
Marketplace_draft must redact restricted or unclear rights
Proof checksum required on exported package
Licensed Index Membership (S&P / MSCI / FTSE / Russell)
